            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Gated cross-attention layers (trainable)
        self.gated_cross_attn_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            GatedCrossAttention(text_dim, hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Output head
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(text_dim, 50257)  # GPT vocab size
        
    def forward(
        self,
        text_input: torch.Tensor,
        image_features: Optional[List[torch.Tensor]] = None,
        image_positions: Optional[List[int]] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Process interleaved text and images
        
        Args:
            text_input: [batch_size, seq_len, text_dim]
            image_features: List of [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            image_positions: Positions in text where images appear
            
        Returns:
            Language model logits
        """
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = text_input.shape
        
        # Process images through perceiver resampler
        visual_tokens = []
        if image_features is not None:
            with torch.no_grad():
                for img_feat in image_features:
                    vision_embeds = self.vision_encoder(img_feat)
            
            # Resample to fixed number of tokens
            visual_tokens = self.perceiver_resampler(vision_embeds)
        
        # Process through language model with gated cross-attention
        hidden_states = text_input
        
        for lm_layer, gated_cross_attn in zip(
            self.lm_layers, self.gated_cross_attn_layers
        ):
            # Standard LM self-attention (frozen)
            with torch.no_grad():
                hidden_states = lm_layer(hidden_states)
            
            # Gated cross-attention to visual tokens (trainable)
            if len(visual_tokens) > 0:
                hidden_states = gated_cross_attn(hidden_states, visual_tokens)
        
        # Generate output logits
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return logits


# ============================================================================
# 3508. KOSMOS Pattern - Language Model with Multimodal Capabilities
# ============================================================================

class KOSMOSPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    KOSMOS: Multimodal Large Language Model
    Unified model for language, vision, and multimodal understanding
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 64000,
        hidden_dim: int = 2048,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_layers: int = 24,
        vision_dim: int = 1024,
        max_positions: int = 2048
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Token embeddings
        self.token_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        self.position_embedding = nn.Embedding(max_positions, hidden_dim)
        
        # Vision encoder
        self.vision_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Vision projection to align with text embeddings
        self.vision_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        
        # Modality type embeddings
        self.modality_embedding = nn.Embedding(3, hidden_dim)  # text, image, code
        
        # Transformer layers
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Output head
        self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size)
        
        # Special tokens
        self.image_token_id = vocab_size - 1
        
    def embed_multimodal_input(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        image_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_positions: Optional[torch.
Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Create embeddings for interleaved text and images
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            image_features: [batch_size, num_images, num_patches, vision_dim]
            image_positions: [batch_size, num_images] positions of image tokens
            
        Returns:
            Combined embeddings [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_dim]
        """
        batch_size, seq_len = input_ids.shape
        
        # Text embeddings
        text_embeds = self.token_embedding(input_ids)
        
        # Position embeddings
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0)
        pos_embeds = self.position_embedding(positions)
        
        # Modality embeddings (0 for text)
        modality_ids = torch.zeros_like(input_ids)
        
        # Process images if provided
        if image_features is not None and image_positions is not None:
            vision_embeds = self.vision_encoder(image_features)
            vision_embeds = self.vision_proj(vision_embeds)
            
            # Insert vision embeddings at specified positions
            for batch_idx in range(batch_size):
                for img_idx, pos in enumerate(image_positions[batch_idx]):
                    if pos < seq_len:
                        # Replace image token with vision embeddings
                        num_patches = vision_embeds.size(2)
                        end_pos = min(pos + num_patches, seq_len)
                        actual_patches = end_pos - pos
                        
                        text_embeds[batch_idx, pos:end_pos] = \
                            vision_embeds[batch_idx, img_idx, :actual_patches]
                        modality_ids[batch_idx, pos:end_pos] = 1  # image modality
        
        modality_embeds = self.modality_embedding(modality_ids)
        
        # Combine all embeddings
        embeddings = text_embeds + pos_embeds + modality_embeds
        
        return embeddings
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        image_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_positions: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Forward pass for multimodal language modeling
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            image_features: [batch_size, num_images, num_patches, vision_dim]
            image_positions: [batch_size, num_images]
            attention_mask: [batch_size, seq_len]
            
        Returns:
            Logits [batch_size, seq_len, vocab_size]
        """
        # Get multimodal embeddings
        hidden_states = self.embed_multimodal_input(
            input_ids, image_features, image_positions
        )
        
        # Apply transformer layers
        for layer in self.layers:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, attention_mask)
        
        # Output projection
        hidden_states = self.output_norm(hidden_states)
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return logits


# ============================================================================
# 3509. GPT-4V Pattern - Vision-Enabled GPT
# ============================================================================

class GPT4VPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    GPT-4V: Vision-enabled GPT architecture
    Integrates vision understanding into autoregressive language model
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 100000,
        hidden_dim: int = 12288,
        num_heads: int = 96,
        num_layers: int = 96,
        vision_dim: int = 1664,
        num_vision_tokens: int = 256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder (high-resolution)
        self.vision_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Vision adapter - compress vision tokens
        self.vision_adapter = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 2),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Token and position embeddings
        self.token_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        self.position_embedding = nn.Embedding(8192, hidden_dim)  # long context
        
        # Transformer decoder layers
        self.decoder_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            GPTBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Layer norm and output
        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size, bias=False)
        
        # Tie weights
        self.lm_head.weight = self.token_embedding.weight
        
    def process_vision(self, image_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Process high-resolution image features
        
        Args:
            image_features: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            
        Returns:
            Vision tokens [batch_size, num_vision_tokens, hidden_dim]
        """
        # Encode vision features
        vision_embeds = self.vision_encoder(image_features)
        
        # Adapt to language model dimension
        vision_tokens = self.vision_adapter(vision_embeds)
        
        return vision_tokens
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        image_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        past_key_values: Optional[List[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]] = None,
        use_cache: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Autoregressive forward pass with optional vision input
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            image_features: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            past_key_values: Cached key-value pairs for efficiency
            use_cache: Whether to return cached states
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with logits and optional cache
        """
        batch_size, seq_len = input_ids.shape
        
        # Text embeddings
        text_embeds = self.token_embedding(input_ids)
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0)
        pos_embeds = self.position_embedding(positions)
        
        hidden_states = text_embeds + pos_embeds
        
        # Prepend vision tokens if provided
        if image_features is not None:
            vision_tokens = self.process_vision(image_features)
            hidden_states = torch.cat([vision_tokens, hidden_states], dim=1)
        
        # Apply decoder layers
        present_key_values = [] if use_cache else None
        
        for i, layer in enumerate(self.decoder_layers):
            layer_past = past_key_values[i] if past_key_values else None
            
            hidden_states, present = layer(
                hidden_states,
                layer_past=layer_past,
                use_cache=use_cache
            )
            
            if use_cache:
                present_key_values.append(present)
        
        # Final norm and projection
        hidden_states = self.final_norm(hidden_states)
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return {
            'logits': logits,
            'past_key_values': present_key_values if use_cache else None
        }


# ============================================================================
# 3510. LLaVA Pattern - Large Language and Vision Assistant
# ============================================================================

class LLaVAPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    LLaVA: Visual instruction tuning for large language models
    Simple but effective vision-language alignment
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_encoder_dim: int = 1024,
        llm_hidden_dim: int = 4096,
        projection_dim: int = 4096,
        num_llm_layers: int = 32,
        num_heads: int = 32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder (CLIP ViT, frozen)
        self.vision_tower = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_encoder_dim, vision_encoder_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(vision_encoder_dim)
        )
        for param in self.vision_tower.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Simple linear projection (trainable)
        self.mm_projector = nn.Linear(vision_encoder_dim, projection_dim)
        
        # Language model (LLaMA, frozen initially)
        self.language_model = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(llm_hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_llm_layers)
        ])
        
        # Token embeddings
        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(32000, llm_hidden_dim)
        
        # Output head
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(llm_hidden_dim, 32000, bias=False)
        
        # Special image token
        self.image_token_id = 32000 - 1
        
    def encode_images(self, images: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode images to language model space
        
        Args:
            images: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_encoder_dim]
            
        Returns:
            Image features [batch_size, num_patches, llm_hidden_dim]
        """
        with torch.no_grad():
            image_features = self.vision_tower(images)
        
        # Project to LLM dimension
        image_features = self.mm_projector(image_features)
        
        return image_features
    
    def prepare_inputs_labels_for_multimodal(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        images: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Merge text and image tokens
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            images: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_encoder_dim]
            
        Returns:
            Merged embeddings
        """
        # Get text embeddings
        inputs_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
        
        if images is None:
            return inputs_embeds
        
        # Encode images
        image_features = self.encode_images(images)
        
        # Find image token positions and replace with image features
        batch_size = input_ids.size(0)
        for batch_idx in range(batch_size):
            image_token_mask = input_ids[batch_idx] == self.image_token_id
            
            if image_token_mask.any():
                # Replace image tokens with actual image features
                image_positions = torch.where(image_token_mask)[0]
                
                # Simple replacement (assumes one image per sequence)
                if len(image_positions) > 0:
                    start_pos = image_positions[0]
                    num_image_tokens = image_features.size(1)
                    
                    # Create new embedding tensor
                    new_embeds = torch.cat([
                        inputs_embeds[batch_idx, :start_pos],
                        image_features[batch_idx],
                        inputs_embeds[batch_idx, start_pos + num_image_tokens:]
                    ], dim=0)
                    
                    inputs_embeds[batch_idx] = new_embeds[:inputs_embeds.size(1)]
        
        return inputs_embeds
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        images: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Forward pass for visual instruction following
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            images: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_encoder_dim]
            labels: [batch_size, seq_len] for training
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with logits and optional loss
        """
        # Prepare multimodal inputs
        inputs_embeds = self.prepare_inputs_labels_for_multimodal(
            input_ids, images
        )
        
        # Pass through language model
        hidden_states = inputs_embeds
        for layer in self.language_model:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        
        # Get logits
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        # Compute loss if labels provided
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            shift_logits = logits[..., :-1, :].contiguous()
            shift_labels = labels[..., 1:].contiguous()
            loss = F.cross_entropy(
                shift_logits.view(-1, shift_logits.size(-1)),
                shift_labels.view(-1)
            )
        
        return {'logits': logits, 'loss': loss}


# ============================================================================
# 3511. MiniGPT-4 Pattern - Aligned Vision-Language Model
# ============================================================================

class MiniGPT4Pattern(nn.Module):
    """
    MiniGPT-4: Enhancing vision-language understanding with advanced LLMs
    Uses Q-Former and projection layer for alignment
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_dim: int = 1408,
        qformer_dim: int = 768,
        llm_dim: int = 5120,
        num_query_tokens: int = 32,
        num_qformer_layers: int = 12,
        num_llm_layers: int = 40,
        num_heads: int = 32
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder (EVA-CLIP, frozen)
        self.visual_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_dim, vision_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(vision_dim)
        )
        for param in self.visual_encoder.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Q-Former from BLIP-2
        self.query_tokens = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(1, num_query_tokens, qformer_dim)
        )
        nn.init.trunc_normal_(self.query_tokens, std=0.02)
        
        self.qformer = nn.ModuleList([
            QFormerBlock(qformer_dim, vision_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_qformer_layers)
        ])
        
        # Linear projection to LLM space (trainable in stage 1)
        self.llm_proj = nn.Linear(qformer_dim, llm_dim)
        
        # LLM (Vicuna, frozen in stage 1, tuned in stage 2)
        self.llm_model = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(llm_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_llm_layers)
        ])
        
        
```python
        # Token embeddings for LLM
        self.llm_tokenizer_embedding = nn.Embedding(32000, llm_dim)
        
        # Output head
        self.llm_head = nn.Linear(llm_dim, 32000, bias=False)
        
        # Prompt template
        self.prompt_template = "###Human: {} ###Assistant: "
        
    def encode_img(self, image: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode image through vision encoder and Q-Former
        
        Args:
            image: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            
        Returns:
            Query outputs [batch_size, num_query_tokens, qformer_dim]
        """
        # Extract image features (frozen)
        with torch.no_grad():
            image_embeds = self.visual_encoder(image)
        
        # Q-Former processing
        batch_size = image.size(0)
        query_tokens = self.query_tokens.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        query_output = query_tokens
        for qformer_layer in self.qformer:
            query_output = qformer_layer(query_output, image_embeds)
        
        return query_output
    
    def forward(
        self,
        image: torch.Tensor,
        text_input: torch.Tensor,
        training_stage: int = 1
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Two-stage training forward pass
        
        Args:
            image: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            text_input: [batch_size, seq_len]
            training_stage: 1 for vision-language alignment, 2 for instruction tuning
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with outputs and loss
        """
        # Encode image
        query_output = self.encode_img(image)
        
        # Project to LLM dimension
        inputs_llm = self.llm_proj(query_output)
        
        # Get text embeddings
        text_embeds = self.llm_tokenizer_embedding(text_input)
        
        # Concatenate image and text embeddings
        inputs_embeds = torch.cat([inputs_llm, text_embeds], dim=1)
        
        # Pass through LLM
        hidden_states = inputs_embeds
        
        if training_stage == 1:
            # Stage 1: Freeze LLM, train projection only
            with torch.no_grad():
                for layer in self.llm_model:
                    hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        else:
            # Stage 2: Fine-tune LLM with LoRA or full tuning
            for layer in self.llm_model:
                hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        
        # Generate logits
        logits = self.llm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return {'logits': logits, 'hidden_states': hidden_states}


# ============================================================================
# 3512. InstructBLIP Pattern - Instruction-Aware Vision-Language Model
# ============================================================================

class InstructBLIPPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    InstructBLIP: Instruction-tuned BLIP-2 for better instruction following
    Adds instruction-aware Q-Former
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_dim: int = 1408,
        qformer_dim: int = 768,
        llm_dim: int = 4096,
        num_query_tokens: int = 32,
        num_qformer_layers: int = 12,
        num_heads: int = 12
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Frozen vision encoder
        self.visual_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_dim, vision_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(vision_dim)
        )
        for param in self.visual_encoder.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Learnable query tokens
        self.query_tokens = nn.Parameter(
            torch.zeros(1, num_query_tokens, qformer_dim)
        )
        
        # Instruction-aware Q-Former
        self.qformer_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            InstructionAwareQFormerBlock(qformer_dim, vision_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_qformer_layers)
        ])
        
        # Text encoder for instructions (within Q-Former)
        self.instruction_encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(qformer_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(6)
        ])
        
        # Projection to LLM
        self.llm_proj = nn.Linear(qformer_dim, llm_dim)
        
        # Frozen LLM (FlanT5 or Vicuna)
        self.llm = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(llm_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(24)
        ])
        for param in self.llm.parameters():
            param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Embeddings
        self.text_embedding = nn.Embedding(32128, qformer_dim)
        self.llm_embedding = nn.Embedding(32128, llm_dim)
        
        # Output
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(llm_dim, 32128)
        
    def encode_instruction(self, instruction_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode instruction text
        
        Args:
            instruction_ids: [batch_size, inst_len]
            
        Returns:
            Instruction embeddings [batch_size, inst_len, qformer_dim]
        """
        inst_embeds = self.text_embedding(instruction_ids)
        
        for layer in self.instruction_encoder:
            inst_embeds = layer(inst_embeds)
        
        return inst_embeds
    
    def forward(
        self,
        image: torch.Tensor,
        instruction_ids: torch.Tensor,
        text_input_ids: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Forward pass with instruction-aware visual encoding
        
        Args:
            image: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            instruction_ids: [batch_size, inst_len]
            text_input_ids: [batch_size, text_len]
            
        Returns:
            Output logits
        """
        batch_size = image.size(0)
        
        # Encode image (frozen)
        with torch.no_grad():
            image_embeds = self.visual_encoder(image)
        
        # Encode instruction
        instruction_embeds = self.encode_instruction(instruction_ids)
        
        # Instruction-aware Q-Former
        query_tokens = self.query_tokens.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        for qformer_layer in self.qformer_layers:
            query_tokens = qformer_layer(
                query_tokens,
                image_embeds,
                instruction_embeds
            )
        
        # Project to LLM space
        query_embeds_llm = self.llm_proj(query_tokens)
        
        # Get text embeddings for LLM
        text_embeds_llm = self.llm_embedding(text_input_ids)
        
        # Concatenate
        inputs_embeds = torch.cat([query_embeds_llm, text_embeds_llm], dim=1)
        
        # Pass through frozen LLM
        hidden_states = inputs_embeds
        with torch.no_grad():
            for layer in self.llm:
                hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        
        # Generate output
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return logits


# ============================================================================
# 3513. Qwen-VL Pattern - Large-Scale Vision-Language Model
# ============================================================================

class QwenVLPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    Qwen-VL: Vision-language version of Qwen with position-aware attention
    Supports high-resolution images and multiple images
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 151936,
        hidden_dim: int = 4096,
        num_heads: int = 32,
        num_layers: int = 32,
        vision_dim: int = 1664,
        image_size: int = 448
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder (ViT)
        self.visual = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Position-aware vision-language adapter
        self.visual_adapter = PositionAwareAdapter(
            vision_dim, hidden_dim, image_size
        )
        
        # Token embeddings
        self.wte = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        
        # Rotary position embeddings (RoPE)
        self.rotary_emb = RotaryEmbedding(hidden_dim // num_heads)
        
        # Transformer layers
        self.h = nn.ModuleList([
            QwenBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Layer norm and output
        self.ln_f = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size, bias=False)
        
        # Special tokens
        self.img_start_token_id = 151857
        self.img_end_token_id = 151858
        self.img_pad_token_id = 151859
        
    def encode_images(
        self,
        images: torch.Tensor,
        image_positions: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode images with position awareness
        
        Args:
            images: [batch_size, num_images, num_patches, vision_dim]
            image_positions: [batch_size, num_images, 4] (x, y, w, h)
            
        Returns:
            Image embeddings with position encoding
        """
        batch_size, num_images, num_patches, _ = images.shape
        
        # Encode visual features
        image_embeds = self.visual(images)
        
        # Add position-aware encoding
        image_embeds = self.visual_adapter(image_embeds, image_positions)
        
        return image_embeds
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        images: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_positions: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Forward pass with multi-image support
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len]
            images: [batch_size, num_images, num_patches, vision_dim]
            image_positions: [batch_size, num_images, 4]
            
        Returns:
            Logits [batch_size, seq_len, vocab_size]
        """
        batch_size, seq_len = input_ids.shape
        
        # Get token embeddings
        hidden_states = self.wte(input_ids)
        
        # Process images if provided
        if images is not None:
            image_embeds = self.encode_images(images, image_positions)
            
            # Replace image placeholder tokens with actual embeddings
            for b in range(batch_size):
                img_start_positions = (input_ids[b] == self.img_start_token_id).nonzero()
                
                for idx, start_pos in enumerate(img_start_positions):
                    if idx < image_embeds.size(1):
                        # Find end position
                        end_positions = (input_ids[b] == self.img_end_token_id).nonzero()
                        if idx < len(end_positions):
                            end_pos = end_positions[idx]
                            
                            # Replace tokens with image embeddings
                            num_img_tokens = end_pos - start_pos - 1
                            actual_tokens = min(num_img_tokens, image_embeds.size(2))
                            
                            hidden_states[b, start_pos+1:start_pos+1+actual_tokens] = \
                                image_embeds[b, idx, :actual_tokens]
        
        # Apply rotary embeddings and transformer layers
        for layer in self.h:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states, self.rotary_emb)
        
        # Final norm and projection
        hidden_states = self.ln_f(hidden_states)
        logits = self.lm_head(hidden_states)
        
        return logits


# ============================================================================
# 3514. mPLUG Pattern - Modular Vision-Language Model
# ============================================================================

class mPLUGPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    mPLUG: Effective and efficient vision-language learning with modular design
    Uses cross-modal skip connections
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_dim: int = 768,
        text_dim: int = 768,
        hidden_dim: int = 768,
        num_heads: int = 12,
        num_vision_layers: int = 12,
        num_text_layers: int = 12,
        num_cross_layers: int = 6
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder
        self.vision_encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(vision_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_vision_layers)
        ])
        
        # Text encoder
        self.text_encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(text_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_text_layers)
        ])
        
        # Cross-modal encoder with skip connections
        self.cross_modal_encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            CrossModalSkipBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_cross_layers)
        ])
        
        # Modular task heads
        self.task_modules = nn.ModuleDict({
            'itm': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 2),  # Image-Text Matching
            'mlm': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 30522),  # Masked Language Modeling
            'caption': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 30522),  # Captioning
            'vqa': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 3129),  # VQA answers
            'retrieval': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        })
        
        # Cross-modal projections
        self.vision_proj = nn.Linear(vision_dim, hidden_dim)
        self.text_proj = nn.Linear(text_dim, hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        vision_input: torch.Tensor,
        text_input: torch.Tensor,
        task: str = 'itm',
        return_embeddings: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Modular forward pass for different tasks
        
        Args:
            vision_input: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            text_input: [batch_size, seq_len, text_dim]
            task: Task to perform
            return_embeddings: Whether to return intermediate embeddings
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with task outputs
        """
        # Encode vision
        v = vision_input
        vision_skip_connections = []
        for i, layer in enumerate
(self.vision_encoder):
            v = layer(v)
            if i % 3 == 0:  # Store skip connections
                vision_skip_connections.append(v)
        
        # Encode text
        t = text_input
        text_skip_connections = []
        for i, layer in enumerate(self.text_encoder):
            t = layer(t)
            if i % 3 == 0:  # Store skip connections
                text_skip_connections.append(t)
        
        # Project to common dimension
        v_proj = self.vision_proj(v)
        t_proj = self.text_proj(t)
        
        # Cross-modal fusion with skip connections
        for i, cross_layer in enumerate(self.cross_modal_encoder):
            # Use skip connections from earlier layers
            skip_idx = min(i, len(vision_skip_connections) - 1)
            v_skip = self.vision_proj(vision_skip_connections[skip_idx])
            t_skip = self.text_proj(text_skip_connections[skip_idx])
            
            v_proj, t_proj = cross_layer(v_proj, t_proj, v_skip, t_skip)
        
        # Task-specific outputs
        results = {}
        
        if task == 'itm':
            # Image-Text Matching
            combined = torch.cat([v_proj.mean(1), t_proj.mean(1)], dim=-1)
            results['itm_logits'] = self.task_modules['itm'](combined)
        
        elif task == 'mlm':
            # Masked Language Modeling
            results['mlm_logits'] = self.task_modules['mlm'](t_proj)
        
        elif task == 'caption':
            # Image Captioning
            results['caption_logits'] = self.task_modules['caption'](t_proj)
        
        elif task == 'vqa':
            # Visual Question Answering
            combined = v_proj.mean(1) + t_proj.mean(1)
            results['vqa_logits'] = self.task_modules['vqa'](combined)
        
        elif task == 'retrieval':
            # Image-Text Retrieval
            v_feat = self.task_modules['retrieval'](v_proj.mean(1))
            t_feat = self.task_modules['retrieval'](t_proj.mean(1))
            results['vision_embeds'] = F.normalize(v_feat, dim=-1)
            results['text_embeds'] = F.normalize(t_feat, dim=-1)
        
        if return_embeddings:
            results['vision_hidden'] = v_proj
            results['text_hidden'] = t_proj
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# 3515. Unified-IO Pattern - Unified I/O for Vision, Language, and More
# ============================================================================

class UnifiedIOPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    Unified-IO: Unified model for diverse vision and language tasks
    Uses unified sequence-to-sequence architecture
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 32128,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_encoder_layers: int = 12,
        num_decoder_layers: int = 12,
        max_image_tokens: int = 256,
        max_text_tokens: int = 512
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Unified vocabulary for text and discretized images
        self.shared_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        
        # Modality embeddings
        self.modality_embeddings = nn.Embedding(4, hidden_dim)  # text, image, audio, video
        
        # Position embeddings
        self.position_embeddings = nn.Embedding(
            max_image_tokens + max_text_tokens, hidden_dim
        )
        
        # Encoder (processes inputs)
        self.encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_encoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Decoder (generates outputs)
        self.decoder = nn.ModuleList([
            DecoderBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_decoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Cross-attention in decoder
        self.cross_attention = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
            for _ in range(num_decoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Task-specific output heads
        self.output_heads = nn.ModuleDict({
            'text': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size),
            'image': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size),  # discretized image tokens
            'bbox': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 4),  # bounding boxes
            'mask': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 256),  # segmentation masks
        })
        
        # VQ-VAE for image tokenization (simplified)
        self.image_tokenizer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size)
        )
        
        self.image_detokenizer = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vocab_size, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 768)
        )
        
    def encode_input(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        modality_ids: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode multimodal input
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len] (unified token IDs)
            modality_ids: [batch_size, seq_len] (0=text, 1=image, etc.)
            
        Returns:
            Encoded representations
        """
        # Token embeddings
        token_embeds = self.shared_embedding(input_ids)
        
        # Modality embeddings
        modality_embeds = self.modality_embeddings(modality_ids)
        
        # Position embeddings
        seq_len = input_ids.size(1)
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0)
        pos_embeds = self.position_embeddings(positions)
        
        # Combine
        hidden_states = token_embeds + modality_embeds + pos_embeds
        
        # Encode
        for layer in self.encoder:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        
        return hidden_states
    
    def decode_output(
        self,
        decoder_input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        output_modality: str = 'text'
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Decode to target modality
        
        Args:
            decoder_input_ids: [batch_size, target_len]
            encoder_hidden_states: [batch_size, src_len, hidden_dim]
            output_modality: Target modality type
            
        Returns:
            Output logits or features
        """
        # Decoder embeddings
        decoder_embeds = self.shared_embedding(decoder_input_ids)
        seq_len = decoder_input_ids.size(1)
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=decoder_input_ids.device).unsqueeze(0)
        decoder_embeds = decoder_embeds + self.position_embeddings(positions)
        
        # Decode
        hidden_states = decoder_embeds
        for decoder_layer, cross_attn in zip(self.decoder, self.cross_attention):
            # Self-attention
            hidden_states = decoder_layer(hidden_states)
            
            # Cross-attention to encoder
            cross_out, _ = cross_attn(
                hidden_states,
                encoder_hidden_states,
                encoder_hidden_states
            )
            hidden_states = hidden_states + cross_out
        
        # Modality-specific output
        if output_modality in self.output_heads:
            output = self.output_heads[output_modality](hidden_states)
        else:
            output = hidden_states
        
        return output
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        input_modality_ids: torch.Tensor,
        decoder_input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        output_modality: str = 'text'
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Unified forward pass for any input-output modality combination
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, src_len]
            input_modality_ids: [batch_size, src_len]
            decoder_input_ids: [batch_size, tgt_len]
            output_modality: Type of output to generate
            
        Returns:
            Output logits/features
        """
        # Encode input
        encoder_hidden = self.encode_input(input_ids, input_modality_ids)
        
        # Decode output
        output = self.decode_output(
            decoder_input_ids,
            encoder_hidden,
            output_modality
        )
        
        return output


# ============================================================================
# 3516. OFA (One For All) Pattern - Unified Multimodal Pre-training
# ============================================================================

class OFAPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    OFA: Unifying architectures, tasks, and modalities through simple sequence-to-sequence
    Uses unified sequence-to-sequence learning
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 59457,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_encoder_layers: int = 12,
        num_decoder_layers: int = 12,
        image_vocab_size: int = 8192,  # For VQ-GAN
        max_positions: int = 1024
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Shared embeddings
        self.embed_tokens = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        self.embed_positions = nn.Embedding(max_positions, hidden_dim)
        
        # Image position embeddings (2D)
        self.embed_image_positions = nn.Embedding(1024, hidden_dim)  # 32x32 max
        
        # Image patch embeddings (for continuous features)
        self.patch_embed = nn.Linear(768, hidden_dim)
        
        # VQ-GAN codebook for discrete image tokens
        self.image_codebook = nn.Embedding(image_vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        
        # Encoder
        self.encoder_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_encoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Decoder
        self.decoder_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            DecoderBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_decoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Cross-attention
        self.decoder_cross_attention = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.MultiheadAttention(hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True)
            for _ in range(num_decoder_layers)
        ])
        
        # Layer norms
        self.encoder_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.decoder_layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
        # Output projections
        self.output_projection = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size, bias=False)
        self.image_output_projection = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, image_vocab_size)
        
    def embed_input(
        self,
        input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_patches: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_codes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        patch_positions: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Unified embedding for text and images
        
        Args:
            input_ids: [batch_size, seq_len] text tokens
            image_patches: [batch_size, num_patches, 768] continuous patches
            image_codes: [batch_size, num_codes] discrete image codes
            patch_positions: [batch_size, num_patches] 2D positions
            
        Returns:
            Embeddings
        """
        embeds_list = []
        
        # Text embeddings
        if input_ids is not None:
            text_embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
            seq_positions = torch.arange(
                input_ids.size(1), device=input_ids.device
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            text_embeds = text_embeds + self.embed_positions(seq_positions)
            embeds_list.append(text_embeds)
        
        # Continuous image patch embeddings
        if image_patches is not None:
            patch_embeds = self.patch_embed(image_patches)
            if patch_positions is not None:
                patch_embeds = patch_embeds + self.embed_image_positions(patch_positions)
            embeds_list.append(patch_embeds)
        
        # Discrete image code embeddings
        if image_codes is not None:
            code_embeds = self.image_codebook(image_codes)
            embeds_list.append(code_embeds)
        
        # Concatenate all embeddings
        if len(embeds_list) > 0:
            return torch.cat(embeds_list, dim=1)
        else:
            raise ValueError("At least one input type must be provided")
    
    def forward(
        self,
        src_tokens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        src_image_patches: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        src_image_codes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        tgt_tokens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        tgt_image_codes: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        task_type: str = 'caption'
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Unified forward for various tasks
        
        Args:
            src_tokens: Source text tokens
            src_image_patches: Source image patches
            src_image_codes: Source image discrete codes
            tgt_tokens: Target text tokens
            tgt_image_codes: Target image codes
            task_type: Type of task (caption, vqa, detection, generation, etc.)
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with outputs
        """
        # Encode source
        encoder_input = self.embed_input(
            input_ids=src_tokens,
            image_patches=src_image_patches,
            image_codes=src_image_codes
        )
        
        encoder_out = encoder_input
        for layer in self.encoder_layers:
            encoder_out = layer(encoder_out)
        encoder_out = self.encoder_layer_norm(encoder_out)
        
        # Decode target
        if tgt_tokens is not None or tgt_image_codes is not None:
            decoder_input = self.embed_input(
                input_ids=tgt_tokens,
                image_codes=tgt_image_codes
            )
            
            decoder_out = decoder_input
            for decoder_layer, cross_attn in zip(
                self.decoder_layers, self.decoder_cross_attention
            ):
                # Self-attention
                decoder_out = decoder_layer(decoder_out)
                
                # Cross-attention
                cross_out, _ = cross_attn(decoder_out, encoder_out, encoder
_out)
                decoder_out = decoder_out + cross_out
            
            decoder_out = self.decoder_layer_norm(decoder_out)
            
            # Task-specific output projection
            if task_type in ['caption', 'vqa', 'text_generation']:
                logits = self.output_projection(decoder_out)
            elif task_type in ['image_generation', 'image_infilling']:
                logits = self.image_output_projection(decoder_out)
            else:
                logits = decoder_out
            
            return {'logits': logits, 'encoder_out': encoder_out}
        
        return {'encoder_out': encoder_out}


# ============================================================================
# 3517. BEiT-3 Pattern - Image as a Foreign Language
# ============================================================================

class BEiT3Pattern(nn.Module):
    """
    BEiT-3: Unified multimodal pre-training with masked data modeling
    Treats images as a foreign language with shared Multiway Transformer
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 64010,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_layers: int = 24,
        image_vocab_size: int = 8192,
        patch_size: int = 16,
        max_text_len: int = 512,
        max_image_len: int = 256
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Shared multiway transformer embeddings
        self.text_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        self.vision_embedding = nn.Embedding(image_vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        
        # Position embeddings
        self.text_pos_embedding = nn.Embedding(max_text_len, hidden_dim)
        self.vision_pos_embedding = nn.Embedding(max_image_len, hidden_dim)
        
        # Modality-specific layer norm
        self.text_layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.vision_layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
        # Multiway Transformer layers
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            MultiwayTransformerBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Output heads for different pre-training tasks
        self.mlm_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size)
        )
        
        self.mim_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, image_vocab_size)
        )
        
        # Image-text matching head
        self.itm_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.Tanh(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 2)
        )
        
        # VQ tokenizer for images (simplified)
        self.image_tokenizer = VQTokenizer(image_vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        text_tokens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        image_tokens: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        vision_language_mode: bool = False,
        task: str = 'mlm'
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Multiway forward pass
        
        Args:
            text_tokens: [batch_size, text_len]
            image_tokens: [batch_size, image_len] (VQ codes)
            vision_language_mode: Whether to fuse vision and language
            task: Pre-training task (mlm, mim, itm)
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with task-specific outputs
        """
        batch_size = text_tokens.size(0) if text_tokens is not None else image_tokens.size(0)
        
        # Prepare embeddings
        text_embeds = None
        vision_embeds = None
        
        if text_tokens is not None:
            text_embeds = self.text_embedding(text_tokens)
            text_pos = torch.arange(
                text_tokens.size(1), device=text_tokens.device
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            text_embeds = text_embeds + self.text_pos_embedding(text_pos)
            text_embeds = self.text_layernorm(text_embeds)
        
        if image_tokens is not None:
            vision_embeds = self.vision_embedding(image_tokens)
            vision_pos = torch.arange(
                image_tokens.size(1), device=image_tokens.device
            ).unsqueeze(0)
            vision_embeds = vision_embeds + self.vision_pos_embedding(vision_pos)
            vision_embeds = self.vision_layernorm(vision_embeds)
        
        # Pass through multiway transformer
        for layer in self.layers:
            text_embeds, vision_embeds = layer(
                text_embeds,
                vision_embeds,
                vision_language_mode
            )
        
        results = {}
        
        # Task-specific outputs
        if task == 'mlm' and text_embeds is not None:
            # Masked Language Modeling
            results['mlm_logits'] = self.mlm_head(text_embeds)
        
        if task == 'mim' and vision_embeds is not None:
            # Masked Image Modeling
            results['mim_logits'] = self.mim_head(vision_embeds)
        
        if task == 'itm' and text_embeds is not None and vision_embeds is not None:
            # Image-Text Matching
            pooled_text = text_embeds.mean(dim=1)
            pooled_vision = vision_embeds.mean(dim=1)
            combined = pooled_text + pooled_vision
            results['itm_logits'] = self.itm_head(combined)
        
        results['text_embeds'] = text_embeds
        results['vision_embeds'] = vision_embeds
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# 3518. ImageBind Pattern - Joint Embedding Space for Multiple Modalities
# ============================================================================

class ImageBindPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    ImageBind: Learns a joint embedding space across six modalities
    Uses image as the binding modality
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        embed_dim: int = 1024,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_layers: int = 12
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Modality-specific encoders
        self.image_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=768, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        self.text_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=512, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        self.audio_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=128, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        self.depth_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=256, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        self.thermal_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=256, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        self.imu_encoder = ModalityEncoder(
            input_dim=64, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_layers
        )
        
        # Projection heads for contrastive learning
        self.projection_heads = nn.ModuleDict({
            'image': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
            'text': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
            'audio': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
            'depth': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
            'thermal': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
            'imu': nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim)
        })
        
        # Temperature parameters for each modality pair
        self.temperature = nn.ParameterDict({
            'image_text': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'image_audio': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'image_depth': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'image_thermal': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'image_imu': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07))
        })
        
    def encode_modality(
        self,
        features: torch.Tensor,
        modality: str
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Encode features from a specific modality
        
        Args:
            features: [batch_size, seq_len, input_dim]
            modality: Modality type
            
        Returns:
            Embeddings [batch_size, embed_dim]
        """
        # Select appropriate encoder
        if modality == 'image':
            embeds = self.image_encoder(features)
        elif modality == 'text':
            embeds = self.text_encoder(features)
        elif modality == 'audio':
            embeds = self.audio_encoder(features)
        elif modality == 'depth':
            embeds = self.depth_encoder(features)
        elif modality == 'thermal':
            embeds = self.thermal_encoder(features)
        elif modality == 'imu':
            embeds = self.imu_encoder(features)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown modality: {modality}")
        
        # Project and normalize
        embeds = self.projection_heads[modality](embeds)
        embeds = F.normalize(embeds, dim=-1)
        
        return embeds
    
    def forward(
        self,
        modality_inputs: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Compute joint embeddings and contrastive losses
        
        Args:
            modality_inputs: Dictionary mapping modality names to features
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with embeddings and losses
        """
        # Encode all available modalities
        embeddings = {}
        for modality, features in modality_inputs.items():
            embeddings[modality] = self.encode_modality(features, modality)
        
        results = {'embeddings': embeddings}
        
        # Compute contrastive losses with image as anchor
        if 'image' in embeddings:
            total_loss = 0
            num_pairs = 0
            
            for modality, embeds in embeddings.items():
                if modality != 'image':
                    # Compute similarity
                    temp_key = f'image_{modality}'
                    if temp_key in self.temperature:
                        logit_scale = self.temperature[temp_key].exp()
                        
                        similarity = logit_scale * embeddings['image'] @ embeds.t()
                        
                        # Contrastive loss
                        batch_size = similarity.size(0)
                        labels = torch.arange(batch_size, device=similarity.device)
                        
                        loss = (
                            F.cross_entropy(similarity, labels) +
                            F.cross_entropy(similarity.t(), labels)
                        ) / 2
                        
                        total_loss += loss
                        num_pairs += 1
                        
                        results[f'loss_{modality}'] = loss
            
            if num_pairs > 0:
                results['total_loss'] = total_loss / num_pairs
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# 3519. LanguageBind Pattern - Language-Centric Multi-Modal Alignment
# ============================================================================

class LanguageBindPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    LanguageBind: Extends CLIP to multi-modal with language as the central modality
    Aligns video, audio, depth, thermal, and point clouds to language
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        text_dim: int = 512,
        embed_dim: int = 512,
        num_heads: int = 8,
        num_text_layers: int = 12,
        num_modality_layers: int = 12
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Text encoder (shared across all modalities)
        self.text_encoder = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(text_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_text_layers)
        ])
        
        # Modality-specific encoders
        self.video_encoder = TemporalEncoder(
            input_dim=768, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_modality_layers
        )
        
        self.audio_encoder = SpectrogramEncoder(
            input_dim=128, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_modality_layers
        )
        
        self.depth_encoder = DepthEncoder(
            input_dim=256, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_modality_layers
        )
        
        self.thermal_encoder = ThermalEncoder(
            input_dim=256, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_modality_layers
        )
        
        self.point_cloud_encoder = PointCloudEncoder(
            input_dim=3, embed_dim=embed_dim, num_heads=num_heads, num_layers=num_modality_layers
        )
        
        # Projection to common embedding space
        self.text_projection = nn.Linear(text_dim, embed_dim)
        
        # Learnable temperature for each modality
        self.logit_scales = nn.ParameterDict({
            'video': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'audio': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'depth': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'thermal': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07)),
            'point_cloud': nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07))
        })
        
    def encode_text(self, text_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Encode text features"""
        x = text_features
        for layer in self.text_encoder:
            x = layer(x)
        
        # Pool and project
        x = x.mean(dim=1)
        x = self.text_projection(x)
        return F.normalize(x, dim=-1)
    
    def forward(
        self,
        text_features: torch.Tensor,
        modality_features: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Language-centric multi-modal
alignment
        
        Args:
            text_features: [batch_size, seq_len, text_dim]
            modality_features: Dictionary with modality features
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with similarities and losses
        """
        # Encode text (shared for all modalities)
        text_embeds = self.encode_text(text_features)
        
        results = {'text_embeds': text_embeds}
        total_loss = 0
        num_modalities = 0
        
        # Process each modality
        for modality, features in modality_features.items():
            # Encode modality
            if modality == 'video':
                modality_embeds = self.video_encoder(features)
            elif modality == 'audio':
                modality_embeds = self.audio_encoder(features)
            elif modality == 'depth':
                modality_embeds = self.depth_encoder(features)
            elif modality == 'thermal':
                modality_embeds = self.thermal_encoder(features)
            elif modality == 'point_cloud':
                modality_embeds = self.point_cloud_encoder(features)
            else:
                continue
            
            # Normalize
            modality_embeds = F.normalize(modality_embeds, dim=-1)
            results[f'{modality}_embeds'] = modality_embeds
            
            # Compute similarity with temperature scaling
            logit_scale = self.logit_scales[modality].exp()
            similarity = logit_scale * text_embeds @ modality_embeds.t()
            
            # Contrastive loss
            batch_size = text_features.size(0)
            labels = torch.arange(batch_size, device=text_features.device)
            
            loss = (
                F.cross_entropy(similarity, labels) +
                F.cross_entropy(similarity.t(), labels)
            ) / 2
            
            results[f'{modality}_similarity'] = similarity
            results[f'{modality}_loss'] = loss
            
            total_loss += loss
            num_modalities += 1
        
        if num_modalities > 0:
            results['total_loss'] = total_loss / num_modalities
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# 3520. AnyMAL Pattern - Any-Modality Augmented Language Model
# ============================================================================

class AnyMALPattern(nn.Module):
    """
    AnyMAL: Unified model that can process and generate any modality
    Uses modality-agnostic architecture with specialized adapters
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size: int = 50000,
        hidden_dim: int = 2048,
        num_heads: int = 16,
        num_layers: int = 32,
        num_modalities: int = 8,
        max_seq_len: int = 4096
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Core language model embeddings
        self.token_embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_dim)
        self.position_embedding = nn.Embedding(max_seq_len, hidden_dim)
        
        # Modality-specific input adapters
        self.input_adapters = nn.ModuleDict({
            'text': nn.Identity(),
            'image': ModalityAdapter(768, hidden_dim),
            'video': ModalityAdapter(1024, hidden_dim),
            'audio': ModalityAdapter(128, hidden_dim),
            'point_cloud': ModalityAdapter(512, hidden_dim),
            'depth': ModalityAdapter(256, hidden_dim),
            'thermal': ModalityAdapter(256, hidden_dim),
            'imu': ModalityAdapter(64, hidden_dim)
        })
        
        # Modality embeddings
        self.modality_type_embedding = nn.Embedding(num_modalities, hidden_dim)
        
        # Unified transformer backbone
        self.transformer_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            TransformerBlock(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        # Modality-specific output heads
        self.output_heads = nn.ModuleDict({
            'text': nn.Linear(hidden_dim, vocab_size),
            'image': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 768),
            'video': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 1024),
            'audio': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 128),
            'point_cloud': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 512),
            'depth': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 256),
            'thermal': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 256),
            'imu': ModalityDecoder(hidden_dim, 64)
        })
        
        # Modality routing mechanism
        self.modality_router = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, num_modalities),
            nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
        )
        
        # Layer norm
        self.final_norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def embed_multimodal_sequence(
        self,
        inputs: List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]],
        modality_types: List[str]
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Create unified embeddings from heterogeneous modality sequence
        
        Args:
            inputs: List of dictionaries with modality-specific features
            modality_types: List of modality type strings
            
        Returns:
            Unified embeddings [batch_size, total_seq_len, hidden_dim]
        """
        batch_size = inputs[0]['features'].size(0)
        all_embeddings = []
        
        for idx, (input_dict, modality) in enumerate(zip(inputs, modality_types)):
            features = input_dict['features']
            
            # Apply modality-specific adapter
            if modality == 'text':
                # Text tokens - use token embedding
                adapted = self.token_embedding(features.long())
            else:
                # Other modalities - use adapter
                adapted = self.input_adapters[modality](features)
            
            # Add modality type embedding
            modality_id = self.get_modality_id(modality)
            modality_embed = self.modality_type_embedding(
                torch.tensor([modality_id], device=features.device)
            ).unsqueeze(0).expand(batch_size, adapted.size(1), -1)
            
            adapted = adapted + modality_embed
            all_embeddings.append(adapted)
        
        # Concatenate all modality embeddings
        combined_embeds = torch.cat(all_embeddings, dim=1)
        
        # Add position embeddings
        seq_len = combined_embeds.size(1)
        positions = torch.arange(seq_len, device=combined_embeds.device).unsqueeze(0)
        pos_embeds = self.position_embedding(positions)
        
        return combined_embeds + pos_embeds
    
    def get_modality_id(self, modality: str) -> int:
        """Map modality string to integer ID"""
        modality_map = {
            'text': 0, 'image': 1, 'video': 2, 'audio': 3,
            'point_cloud': 4, 'depth': 5, 'thermal': 6, 'imu': 7
        }
        return modality_map.get(modality, 0)
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_sequence: List[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]],
        input_modalities: List[str],
        output_modality: str = 'text',
        generate: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Process any-modality input and generate any-modality output
        
        Args:
            input_sequence: List of modality inputs
            input_modalities: List of modality type strings
            output_modality: Target output modality
            generate: Whether to use autoregressive generation
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with outputs
        """
        # Embed multimodal sequence
        hidden_states = self.embed_multimodal_sequence(
            input_sequence, input_modalities
        )
        
        # Process through transformer
        for layer in self.transformer_layers:
            hidden_states = layer(hidden_states)
        
        hidden_states = self.final_norm(hidden_states)
        
        # Route to appropriate output head
        if output_modality in self.output_heads:
            output = self.output_heads[output_modality](hidden_states)
        else:
            output = hidden_states
        
        # Compute modality routing weights (for interpretability)
        routing_weights = self.modality_router(hidden_states.mean(dim=1))
        
        return {
            'output': output,
            'hidden_states': hidden_states,
            'routing_weights': routing_weights
        }


# ============================================================================
# Helper Components Used Across Patterns
# ============================================================================

class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    """Standard Transformer block with self-attention and FFN"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int, num_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 4, hidden_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Self-attention
        attn_out, _ = self.attention(x, x, x, attn_mask=attention_mask)
        x = self.norm1(x + attn_out)
        
        # FFN
        ffn_out = self.ffn(x)
        x = self.norm2(x + ffn_out)
        
        return x


class DecoderBlock(nn.Module):
    """Transformer decoder block with causal self-attention"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int, num_heads: int, dropout: float = 0.1):
        super().__init__()
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout, batch_first=True
        )
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 4, hidden_dim),
            nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Causal self-attention
        seq_len = x.size(1)
        causal_mask = torch.triu(
            torch.ones(seq_len, seq_len, device=x.device) * float('-inf'),
            diagonal=1
        )
        
        attn_out, _ = self.self_attention(x, x, x, attn_mask=causal_mask)
        x = self.norm1(x + attn_out)
        
        # FFN
        ffn_out = self.ffn(x)
        x = self.norm2(x + ffn_out)
        
        return x


class CrossModalFusion(nn.Module):
    """Cross-modal fusion layer"""
    def __init__(self, vision_dim: int, text_dim: int, num_heads: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.vision_to_text = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            text_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.text_to_vision = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            vision_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.vision_norm = nn.LayerNorm(vision_dim)
        self.text_norm = nn.LayerNorm(text_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        vision_features: torch.Tensor,
        text_features: torch.Tensor
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        # Text attends to vision
        t2v, _ = self.text_to_vision(text_features, vision_features, vision_features)
        text_out = self.text_norm(text_features + t2v)
        
        # Vision attends to text
        v2t, _ = self.vision_to_text(vision_features, text_features, text_features)
        vision_out = self.vision_norm(vision_features + v2t)
        
        return vision_out, text_out


class AttentionalPooler(nn.Module):
    """Attentional pooling mechanism"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int, num_heads: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
        self.attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        
    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size = x.size(0)
        query = self.query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        pooled, _ = self.attention(query, x, x)
        return pooled.squeeze(1)


class GatedCrossAttention(nn.Module):
    """Gated cross-attention for Flamingo"""
    def __init__(self, text_dim: int, vision_dim: int, num_heads: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            text_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.gate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(text_dim)
        
        # Project vision to text dimension if needed
        self.vision_proj = nn.Linear(vision_dim, text_dim) if vision_dim != text_dim else nn.Identity()
        
    def forward(
        self,
        text_hidden: torch.Tensor,
        vision_hidden: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        vision_proj = self.vision_proj(vision_hidden)
        attn_out, _ = self.cross_attn(text_hidden, vision_proj, vision_proj)
        
        # Gated residual
        gated_attn = torch.tanh(self.gate) * attn_out
        return self.norm(text_hidden + gated_attn)


class PerceiverResampler(nn.Module):
    """Perceiver Resampler for Flamingo"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_dim: int,
        hidden_dim: int,
        num_latents: int,
        num_heads: int,
        num_layers: int = 6
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.latents = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, num_
latents, hidden_dim))
        
        self.vision_proj = nn.Linear(vision_dim, hidden_dim)
        
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            PerceiverResamplerLayer(hidden_dim, num_heads)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(self, vision_features: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Resample vision features to fixed number of tokens
        
        Args:
            vision_features: [batch_size, num_patches, vision_dim]
            
        Returns:
            Resampled features [batch_size, num_latents, hidden_dim]
        """
        batch_size = vision_features.size(0)
        
        # Project vision features
        vision_proj = self.vision_proj(vision_features)
        
        # Expand latents for batch
        latents = self.latents.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        # Apply perceiver layers
        for layer in self.layers:
            latents = layer(latents, vision_proj)
        
        return self.norm(latents)


class PerceiverResamplerLayer(nn.Module):
    """Single layer of Perceiver Resampler"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int, num_heads: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 4, hidden_dim)
        )
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        latents: torch.Tensor,
        context: torch.Tensor
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Cross-attention to context
        cross_out, _ = self.cross_attn(latents, context, context)
        latents = self.norm1(latents + cross_out)
        
        # Self-attention
        self_out, _ = self.self_attn(latents, latents, latents)
        latents = self.norm2(latents + self_out)
        
        # FFN
        ffn_out = self.ffn(latents)
        latents = self.norm3(latents + ffn_out)
        
        return latents


class GPTBlock(nn.Module):
    """GPT-style decoder block with optional caching"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int, num_heads: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.ln_1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            hidden_dim, num_heads, batch_first=True
        )
        self.ln_2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim * 4),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 4, hidden_dim)
        )
        
    def forward(
```
