"""
Multimodal LLM Patterns Implementation in PyTorch
Author: AI Assistant
Description: Complete implementation of 20 multimodal LLM architectural patterns
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List, Dict
from einops import rearrange, repeat
import math


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3781: Visual Instruction Tuning Pattern
# ============================================================================
class VisualInstructionTuning(nn.Module):
    """
    Enables LLMs to follow visual instructions by combining visual and text inputs.
    Similar to LLaVA architecture - trains on instruction-following data with images.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        vision_hidden_size: int = 1024,
        text_hidden_size: int = 4096,
        num_visual_tokens: int = 256,
        projection_dim: int = 4096
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision encoder (e.g., CLIP ViT)
        self.vision_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(vision_hidden_size, projection_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(projection_dim, projection_dim)
        )
        
        # Visual-to-text projection
        self.visual_projection = nn.Linear(projection_dim, text_hidden_size)
        
        # Instruction prefix embeddings
        self.instruction_prefix = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, 1, text_hidden_size)
        )
        
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N, vision_hidden_size]
        text_embeddings: torch.Tensor,   # [B, L, text_hidden_size]
        instruction_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            visual_features: Encoded visual features from vision encoder
            text_embeddings: Text token embeddings
            instruction_mask: Mask indicating instruction positions
            
        Returns:
            Combined multimodal embeddings ready for LLM processing
        """
        batch_size = visual_features.shape[0]
        
        # Encode and project visual features
        encoded_visual = self.vision_encoder(visual_features)  # [B, N, projection_dim]
        projected_visual = self.visual_projection(encoded_visual)  # [B, N, text_hidden_size]
        
        # Add instruction prefix
        instruction_prefix = self.instruction_prefix.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        # Concatenate: [instruction_prefix | visual_tokens | text_tokens]
        combined_embeddings = torch.cat([
            instruction_prefix,
            projected_visual,
            text_embeddings
        ], dim=1)
        
        return combined_embeddings


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3782: Language-Guided Visual Understanding Pattern
# ============================================================================
class LanguageGuidedVisualUnderstanding(nn.Module):
    """
    Uses language queries to guide visual feature extraction.
    Implements attention-based visual grounding with language guidance.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        visual_dim: int = 768,
        language_dim: int = 768,
        num_attention_heads: int = 12,
        dropout: float = 0.1
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_heads = num_attention_heads
        self.head_dim = visual_dim // num_attention_heads
        
        # Language-to-visual attention
        self.query_proj = nn.Linear(language_dim, visual_dim)
        self.key_proj = nn.Linear(visual_dim, visual_dim)
        self.value_proj = nn.Linear(visual_dim, visual_dim)
        
        self.output_proj = nn.Linear(visual_dim, visual_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        
        # Gating mechanism for language guidance
        self.gate = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(language_dim + visual_dim, visual_dim),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
        
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_v, visual_dim]
        language_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_l, language_dim]
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            visual_features: Visual tokens from image encoder
            language_features: Language tokens from text encoder
            attention_mask: Optional mask for attention computation
            
        Returns:
            Language-guided visual features
        """
        batch_size, num_visual, _ = visual_features.shape
        
        # Project language features to queries
        queries = self.query_proj(language_features)  # [B, N_l, visual_dim]
        keys = self.key_proj(visual_features)  # [B, N_v, visual_dim]
        values = self.value_proj(visual_features)  # [B, N_v, visual_dim]
        
        # Reshape for multi-head attention
        queries = rearrange(queries, 'b n (h d) -> b h n d', h=self.num_heads)
        keys = rearrange(keys, 'b n (h d) -> b h n d', h=self.num_heads)
        values = rearrange(values, 'b n (h d) -> b h n d', h=self.num_heads)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_scores = torch.matmul(queries, keys.transpose(-2, -1))
        attention_scores = attention_scores / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)
        
        if attention_mask is not None:
            attention_scores = attention_scores.masked_fill(
                attention_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2) == 0, float('-inf')
            )
        
        attention_probs = F.softmax(attention_scores, dim=-1)
        attention_probs = self.dropout(attention_probs)
        
        # Apply attention to values
        attended_features = torch.matmul(attention_probs, values)
        attended_features = rearrange(attended_features, 'b h n d -> b n (h d)')
        
        # Output projection
        output = self.output_proj(attended_features)
        
        # Gating mechanism - combine original visual with language-guided features
        # Pool language features
        pooled_language = language_features.mean(dim=1, keepdim=True)
        pooled_language = pooled_language.expand(-1, num_visual, -1)
        
        gate_input = torch.cat([pooled_language, visual_features], dim=-1)
        gate_values = self.gate(gate_input)
        
        # Weighted combination
        guided_visual = gate_values * output + (1 - gate_values) * visual_features
        
        return guided_visual


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3783: Cross-Modal Alignment in LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class CrossModalAlignment(nn.Module):
    """
    Aligns different modalities in a shared embedding space using contrastive learning.
    Implements CLIP-style alignment with temperature-scaled contrastive loss.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        visual_dim: int = 768,
        text_dim: int = 768,
        projection_dim: int = 512,
        temperature: float = 0.07
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.temperature = nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(temperature))
        
        # Projection heads for alignment
        self.visual_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(visual_dim, projection_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(projection_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(projection_dim, projection_dim)
        )
        
        self.text_projection = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(text_dim, projection_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(projection_dim),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(projection_dim, projection_dim)
        )
        
        # Learnable logit scale (similar to CLIP)
        self.logit_scale = nn.Parameter(torch.ones([]) * math.log(1 / 0.07))
        
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, visual_dim]
        text_features: torch.Tensor,     # [B, text_dim]
        return_loss: bool = True
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            visual_features: Global visual features (e.g., CLS token)
            text_features: Global text features (e.g., pooled)
            return_loss: Whether to compute contrastive loss
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary containing aligned features and optional loss
        """
        # Project to shared space
        visual_embeds = self.visual_projection(visual_features)
        text_embeds = self.text_projection(text_features)
        
        # Normalize embeddings
        visual_embeds = F.normalize(visual_embeds, p=2, dim=-1)
        text_embeds = F.normalize(text_embeds, p=2, dim=-1)
        
        results = {
            'visual_embeds': visual_embeds,
            'text_embeds': text_embeds
        }
        
        if return_loss:
            # Compute similarity matrix
            logit_scale = self.logit_scale.exp()
            logits_per_visual = logit_scale * visual_embeds @ text_embeds.t()
            logits_per_text = logits_per_visual.t()
            
            # Contrastive loss (symmetric)
            batch_size = visual_features.shape[0]
            labels = torch.arange(batch_size, device=visual_features.device)
            
            loss_visual = F.cross_entropy(logits_per_visual, labels)
            loss_text = F.cross_entropy(logits_per_text, labels)
            
            results['contrastive_loss'] = (loss_visual + loss_text) / 2
            results['logits_per_visual'] = logits_per_visual
            results['logits_per_text'] = logits_per_text
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3784: Visual Tokenization Pattern
# ============================================================================
class VisualTokenization(nn.Module):
    """
    Converts visual inputs into discrete tokens similar to text tokens.
    Implements patch-based tokenization with learnable position embeddings.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        image_size: int = 224,
        patch_size: int = 16,
        in_channels: int = 3,
        embed_dim: int = 768,
        use_cls_token: bool = True
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.image_size = image_size
        self.patch_size = patch_size
        self.num_patches = (image_size // patch_size) ** 2
        self.use_cls_token = use_cls_token
        
        # Patch embedding via convolution
        self.patch_embed = nn.Conv2d(
            in_channels, embed_dim,
            kernel_size=patch_size,
            stride=patch_size
        )
        
        # CLS token for global representation
        if use_cls_token:
            self.cls_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, embed_dim))
            num_positions = self.num_patches + 1
        else:
            num_positions = self.num_patches
        
        # Position embeddings
        self.position_embeddings = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, num_positions, embed_dim)
        )
        
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        
    def forward(self, images: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            images: Input images [B, C, H, W]
            
        Returns:
            Visual tokens [B, N, embed_dim]
        """
        batch_size = images.shape[0]
        
        # Extract patches and embed
        patch_embeddings = self.patch_embed(images)  # [B, embed_dim, H/P, W/P]
        patch_embeddings = rearrange(patch_embeddings, 'b c h w -> b (h w) c')
        
        # Add CLS token if needed
        if self.use_cls_token:
            cls_tokens = self.cls_token.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
            patch_embeddings = torch.cat([cls_tokens, patch_embeddings], dim=1)
        
        # Add position embeddings
        embeddings = patch_embeddings + self.position_embeddings
        embeddings = self.dropout(embeddings)
        
        return embeddings


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3785: Image Encoder Integration Pattern
# ============================================================================
class ImageEncoderIntegration(nn.Module):
    """
    Integrates a pre-trained image encoder (e.g., CLIP, DINOv2) with an LLM.
    Handles feature extraction, projection, and optional adapter layers.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        encoder_hidden_size: int = 1024,
        llm_hidden_size: int = 4096,
        num_adapter_layers: int = 2,
        freeze_encoder: bool = True,
        use_adapter: bool = True
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.freeze_encoder = freeze_encoder
        self.use_adapter = use_adapter
        
        # Placeholder for pre-trained encoder (would be loaded separately)
        self.image_encoder = self._create_dummy_encoder(encoder_hidden_size)
        
        if freeze_encoder:
            for param in self.image_encoder.parameters():
                param.requires_grad = False
        
        # Adapter layers for fine-grained control
        if use_adapter:
            adapter_layers = []
            current_dim = encoder_hidden_size
            
            for i in range(num_adapter_layers):
                is_last = (i == num_adapter_layers - 1)
                next_dim = llm_hidden_size if is_last else encoder_hidden_size
                
                adapter_layers.extend([
                    nn.Linear(current_dim, next_dim),
                    nn.LayerNorm(next_dim),
                    nn.GELU() if not is_last else nn.Identity()
                ])
                current_dim = next_dim
            
            self.adapter = nn.Sequential(*adapter_layers)
        else:
            # Simple linear projection
            self.adapter = nn.Linear(encoder_hidden_size, llm_hidden_size)
        
    def _create_dummy_encoder(self, hidden_size: int) -> nn.Module:
        """Creates a simple dummy encoder for demonstration"""
        return nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(768, hidden_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size)
        )
    
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_inputs: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N, input_dim] or [B, C, H, W]
        output_hidden_states: bool = False
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            visual_inputs: Raw visual inputs or pre-extracted features
            output_hidden_states: Whether to return intermediate features
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with projected features and optional hidden states
```python
        """
        # Extract features from encoder
        if self.freeze_encoder:
            with torch.no_grad():
                encoder_features = self.image_encoder(visual_inputs)
        else:
            encoder_features = self.image_encoder(visual_inputs)
        
        # Project to LLM space
        projected_features = self.adapter(encoder_features)
        
        results = {
            'projected_features': projected_features,
            'encoder_features': encoder_features if output_hidden_states else None
        }
        
        return results


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3786: Visual Feature Projection Pattern
# ============================================================================
class VisualFeatureProjection(nn.Module):
    """
    Projects visual features to match LLM embedding space with multiple strategies.
    Supports linear, MLP, and attention-based projection methods.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        visual_dim: int = 1024,
        llm_dim: int = 4096,
        projection_type: str = 'mlp',  # 'linear', 'mlp', 'attention'
        num_query_tokens: int = 32,
        intermediate_dim: int = 2048
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.projection_type = projection_type
        self.num_query_tokens = num_query_tokens
        
        if projection_type == 'linear':
            # Simple linear projection
            self.projector = nn.Linear(visual_dim, llm_dim)
            
        elif projection_type == 'mlp':
            # Multi-layer perceptron projection
            self.projector = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(visual_dim, intermediate_dim),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.LayerNorm(intermediate_dim),
                nn.Linear(intermediate_dim, llm_dim),
                nn.LayerNorm(llm_dim)
            )
            
        elif projection_type == 'attention':
            # Attention-based projection with learnable queries
            self.query_tokens = nn.Parameter(
                torch.randn(1, num_query_tokens, llm_dim)
            )
            
            self.cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=llm_dim,
                num_heads=16,
                kdim=visual_dim,
                vdim=visual_dim,
                batch_first=True
            )
            
            self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(llm_dim, intermediate_dim),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Linear(intermediate_dim, llm_dim)
            )
            
            self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(llm_dim)
            self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(llm_dim)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown projection type: {projection_type}")
    
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N, visual_dim]
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            visual_features: Visual features from encoder
            attention_mask: Optional mask for visual features
            
        Returns:
            Projected features in LLM space
        """
        if self.projection_type in ['linear', 'mlp']:
            return self.projector(visual_features)
        
        elif self.projection_type == 'attention':
            batch_size = visual_features.shape[0]
            
            # Expand query tokens for batch
            queries = self.query_tokens.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
            
            # Cross-attention: queries attend to visual features
            attended, _ = self.cross_attention(
                query=queries,
                key=visual_features,
                value=visual_features,
                key_padding_mask=attention_mask
            )
            
            # Residual connection and normalization
            queries = self.norm1(queries + attended)
            
            # Feed-forward network
            ffn_output = self.ffn(queries)
            output = self.norm2(queries + ffn_output)
            
            return output


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3787: Cross-Attention Vision-Language Pattern
# ============================================================================
class CrossAttentionVisionLanguage(nn.Module):
    """
    Implements bidirectional cross-attention between vision and language modalities.
    Allows both modalities to attend to each other for deep fusion.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        hidden_size: int = 768,
        num_attention_heads: int = 12,
        num_layers: int = 6,
        intermediate_size: int = 3072,
        dropout: float = 0.1
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            CrossAttentionLayer(
                hidden_size=hidden_size,
                num_attention_heads=num_attention_heads,
                intermediate_size=intermediate_size,
                dropout=dropout
            )
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
    def forward(
        self,
        vision_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_v, hidden_size]
        language_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_l, hidden_size]
        vision_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        language_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            vision_features: Visual token representations
            language_features: Language token representations
            vision_mask: Attention mask for vision tokens
            language_mask: Attention mask for language tokens
            
        Returns:
            Tuple of (fused_vision_features, fused_language_features)
        """
        for layer in self.layers:
            vision_features, language_features = layer(
                vision_features,
                language_features,
                vision_mask,
                language_mask
            )
        
        return vision_features, language_features


class CrossAttentionLayer(nn.Module):
    """Single layer of cross-attention between vision and language"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        hidden_size: int,
        num_attention_heads: int,
        intermediate_size: int,
        dropout: float
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Vision to Language cross-attention
        self.v2l_cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Language to Vision cross-attention
        self.l2v_cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Self-attention for both modalities
        self.vision_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        self.language_self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            dropout=dropout,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Feed-forward networks
        self.vision_ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, intermediate_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(intermediate_size, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        
        self.language_ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, intermediate_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Dropout(dropout),
            nn.Linear(intermediate_size, hidden_size),
            nn.Dropout(dropout)
        )
        
        # Layer normalization
        self.vision_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.vision_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.vision_norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        
        self.language_norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.language_norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.language_norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        vision_features: torch.Tensor,
        language_features: torch.Tensor,
        vision_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        language_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        
        # Vision self-attention
        v_self_attn_out, _ = self.vision_self_attn(
            vision_features, vision_features, vision_features,
            key_padding_mask=vision_mask
        )
        vision_features = self.vision_norm1(vision_features + v_self_attn_out)
        
        # Language self-attention
        l_self_attn_out, _ = self.language_self_attn(
            language_features, language_features, language_features,
            key_padding_mask=language_mask
        )
        language_features = self.language_norm1(language_features + l_self_attn_out)
        
        # Vision to Language cross-attention
        v2l_out, _ = self.v2l_cross_attention(
            query=language_features,
            key=vision_features,
            value=vision_features,
            key_padding_mask=vision_mask
        )
        language_features = self.language_norm2(language_features + v2l_out)
        
        # Language to Vision cross-attention
        l2v_out, _ = self.l2v_cross_attention(
            query=vision_features,
            key=language_features,
            value=language_features,
            key_padding_mask=language_mask
        )
        vision_features = self.vision_norm2(vision_features + l2v_out)
        
        # Feed-forward networks
        vision_features = self.vision_norm3(
            vision_features + self.vision_ffn(vision_features)
        )
        language_features = self.language_norm3(
            language_features + self.language_ffn(language_features)
        )
        
        return vision_features, language_features


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3788: Q-Former Pattern
# ============================================================================
class QFormer(nn.Module):
    """
    Query Transformer (Q-Former) from BLIP-2.
    Uses learnable query tokens to extract visual features relevant to text.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_query_tokens: int = 32,
        hidden_size: int = 768,
        num_hidden_layers: int = 12,
        num_attention_heads: int = 12,
        intermediate_size: int = 3072,
        vision_hidden_size: int = 1024
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_query_tokens = num_query_tokens
        
        # Learnable query tokens
        self.query_tokens = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, num_query_tokens, hidden_size)
        )
        
        # Vision projection to match Q-Former hidden size
        self.vision_projection = nn.Linear(vision_hidden_size, hidden_size)
        
        # Q-Former transformer layers
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            QFormerLayer(
                hidden_size=hidden_size,
                num_attention_heads=num_attention_heads,
                intermediate_size=intermediate_size
            )
            for _ in range(num_hidden_layers)
        ])
        
        self.layernorm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        vision_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_v, vision_hidden_size]
        text_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # [B, N_t, hidden_size]
        text_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            vision_features: Visual features from image encoder
            text_features: Optional text features for text-aware extraction
            text_mask: Attention mask for text features
            
        Returns:
            Query outputs that represent visual information
        """
        batch_size = vision_features.shape[0]
        
        # Project vision features
        vision_features = self.vision_projection(vision_features)
        
        # Expand query tokens for batch
        query_tokens = self.query_tokens.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        # Process through Q-Former layers
        for layer in self.layers:
            query_tokens = layer(
                query_embeds=query_tokens,
                vision_features=vision_features,
                text_features=text_features,
                text_mask=text_mask
            )
        
        query_tokens = self.layernorm(query_tokens)
        
        return query_tokens


class QFormerLayer(nn.Module):
    """Single Q-Former layer with self-attention and cross-attention"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        hidden_size: int,
        num_attention_heads: int,
        intermediate_size: int
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Self-attention on queries
        self.self_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Cross-attention to vision
        self.vision_cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Cross-attention to text (optional)
        self.text_cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_size,
            num_heads=num_attention_heads,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Feed-forward network
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_size, intermediate_size),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(intermediate_size, hidden_size)
        )
        
        # Layer norms
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        self.norm4 = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        query_embeds: torch.Tensor,
        vision_features: torch.Tensor,
        text_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        text_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        
        # Self-attention on queries
        self_attn_out, _ = self.self_attention(
            query_embeds, query_embeds, query_embeds
        )
        query_embeds = self.norm1(query_embeds + self_attn_out)
        
        # Cross-attention to vision
        vision_attn_out, _ = self.vision_cross_attention(
            query=query_embeds,
            key=vision_features,
            value=vision_features
        )
        query_embeds = self.norm2(query_embeds + vision_attn_out)
        
        # Cross-attention to text (if provided)
```python
        if text_features is not None:
            text_attn_out, _ = self.text_cross_attention(
                query=query_embeds,
                key=text_features,
                value=text_features,
                key_padding_mask=text_mask
            )
            query_embeds = self.norm3(query_embeds + text_attn_out)
        
        # Feed-forward network
        ffn_out = self.ffn(query_embeds)
        query_embeds = self.norm4(query_embeds + ffn_out)
        
        return query_embeds


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3789: Perceiver Resampler Pattern
# ============================================================================
class PerceiverResampler(nn.Module):
    """
    Perceiver-based resampling of visual features to a fixed number of tokens.
    Inspired by Flamingo's approach to handle variable-length visual inputs.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_latents: int = 64,
        latent_dim: int = 1024,
        input_dim: int = 768,
        num_layers: int = 6,
        num_heads: int = 8,
        head_dim: int = 64,
        ff_mult: int = 4
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_latents = num_latents
        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
        
        # Learnable latent queries
        self.latents = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_latents, latent_dim))
        
        # Input projection
        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(input_dim, latent_dim)
        
        # Perceiver layers
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList([
            PerceiverResamplerLayer(
                dim=latent_dim,
                num_heads=num_heads,
                head_dim=head_dim,
                ff_mult=ff_mult
            )
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(latent_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N, input_dim] - variable length input
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            x: Input features of variable length
            attention_mask: Optional mask for input features
            
        Returns:
            Resampled features of fixed length [B, num_latents, latent_dim]
        """
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        
        # Project input to latent dimension
        x = self.input_proj(x)
        
        # Expand latents for batch
        latents = repeat(self.latents, 'n d -> b n d', b=batch_size)
        
        # Process through Perceiver layers
        for layer in self.layers:
            latents = layer(latents, x, attention_mask)
        
        return self.norm(latents)


class PerceiverResamplerLayer(nn.Module):
    """Single Perceiver resampler layer"""
    def __init__(
        self,
        dim: int,
        num_heads: int = 8,
        head_dim: int = 64,
        ff_mult: int = 4
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = head_dim
        inner_dim = num_heads * head_dim
        
        # Cross-attention: latents attend to input
        self.cross_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=dim,
            num_heads=num_heads,
            kdim=dim,
            vdim=dim,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Self-attention on latents
        self.self_attn = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=dim,
            num_heads=num_heads,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        # Feed-forward network
        self.ff = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(dim, dim * ff_mult),
            nn.GELU(),
            nn.Linear(dim * ff_mult, dim)
        )
        
        # Layer norms
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        self.norm3 = nn.LayerNorm(dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        latents: torch.Tensor,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        
        # Cross-attention: latents attend to input
        cross_out, _ = self.cross_attn(
            query=latents,
            key=x,
            value=x,
            key_padding_mask=mask
        )
        latents = self.norm1(latents + cross_out)
        
        # Self-attention on latents
        self_out, _ = self.self_attn(latents, latents, latents)
        latents = self.norm2(latents + self_out)
        
        # Feed-forward
        ff_out = self.ff(latents)
        latents = self.norm3(latents + ff_out)
        
        return latents


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3790: Visual Prompt Tuning Pattern
# ============================================================================
class VisualPromptTuning(nn.Module):
    """
    Adds learnable visual prompts to guide model behavior without fine-tuning.
    Implements both prefix-based and adapter-based visual prompting.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        num_prompt_tokens: int = 10,
        hidden_size: int = 768,
        prompt_type: str = 'prefix',  # 'prefix', 'suffix', 'both'
        deep_prompting: bool = False,
        num_layers: int = 12
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_prompt_tokens = num_prompt_tokens
        self.prompt_type = prompt_type
        self.deep_prompting = deep_prompting
        self.num_layers = num_layers
        
        if deep_prompting:
            # Layer-specific prompts
            if prompt_type in ['prefix', 'both']:
                self.prefix_prompts = nn.ParameterList([
                    nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, num_prompt_tokens, hidden_size))
                    for _ in range(num_layers)
                ])
            
            if prompt_type in ['suffix', 'both']:
                self.suffix_prompts = nn.ParameterList([
                    nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, num_prompt_tokens, hidden_size))
                    for _ in range(num_layers)
                ])
        else:
            # Shallow prompting (input level only)
            if prompt_type in ['prefix', 'both']:
                self.prefix_prompt = nn.Parameter(
                    torch.randn(1, num_prompt_tokens, hidden_size)
                )
            
            if prompt_type in ['suffix', 'both']:
                self.suffix_prompt = nn.Parameter(
                    torch.randn(1, num_prompt_tokens, hidden_size)
                )
        
        # Prompt dropout
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.1)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N, hidden_size]
        layer_idx: Optional[int] = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            hidden_states: Input hidden states
            layer_idx: Layer index for deep prompting
            
        Returns:
            Hidden states with visual prompts added
        """
        batch_size = hidden_states.shape[0]
        
        if self.deep_prompting and layer_idx is not None:
            # Use layer-specific prompts
            if self.prompt_type in ['prefix', 'both']:
                prefix = self.prefix_prompts[layer_idx].expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
                prefix = self.dropout(prefix)
                hidden_states = torch.cat([prefix, hidden_states], dim=1)
            
            if self.prompt_type in ['suffix', 'both']:
                suffix = self.suffix_prompts[layer_idx].expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
                suffix = self.dropout(suffix)
                hidden_states = torch.cat([hidden_states, suffix], dim=1)
        else:
            # Shallow prompting
            if self.prompt_type in ['prefix', 'both']:
                prefix = self.prefix_prompt.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
                prefix = self.dropout(prefix)
                hidden_states = torch.cat([prefix, hidden_states], dim=1)
            
            if self.prompt_type in ['suffix', 'both']:
                suffix = self.suffix_prompt.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
                suffix = self.dropout(suffix)
                hidden_states = torch.cat([hidden_states, suffix], dim=1)
        
        return hidden_states


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3791: Multi-Resolution Visual Input Pattern
# ============================================================================
class MultiResolutionVisualInput(nn.Module):
    """
    Processes images at multiple resolutions to capture both global and local details.
    Implements pyramid-style feature extraction and fusion.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        resolutions: List[int] = [224, 384, 512],
        patch_size: int = 16,
        embed_dim: int = 768,
        fusion_method: str = 'concat'  # 'concat', 'add', 'attention'
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.resolutions = resolutions
        self.fusion_method = fusion_method
        
        # Separate patch embeddings for each resolution
        self.patch_embedders = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Conv2d(3, embed_dim, kernel_size=patch_size, stride=patch_size)
            for _ in resolutions
        ])
        
        # Position embeddings for each resolution
        self.position_embeddings = nn.ParameterList([
            nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, (res // patch_size) ** 2, embed_dim))
            for res in resolutions
        ])
        
        # Fusion mechanism
        if fusion_method == 'concat':
            # Simple concatenation along sequence dimension
            self.fusion = nn.Identity()
        elif fusion_method == 'add':
            # Weighted addition
            self.fusion_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(len(resolutions)))
        elif fusion_method == 'attention':
            # Attention-based fusion
            self.fusion_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=embed_dim,
                num_heads=12,
                batch_first=True
            )
            self.fusion_query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, embed_dim))
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        images: List[torch.Tensor]  # List of [B, 3, H_i, W_i] for each resolution
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            images: List of images at different resolutions
            
        Returns:
            Fused multi-resolution features
        """
        batch_size = images[0].shape[0]
        all_features = []
        
        # Process each resolution
        for img, embedder, pos_embed in zip(
            images, self.patch_embedders, self.position_embeddings
        ):
            # Extract patches
            patches = embedder(img)  # [B, embed_dim, H/P, W/P]
            patches = rearrange(patches, 'b c h w -> b (h w) c')
            
            # Add position embeddings
            features = patches + pos_embed
            all_features.append(features)
        
        # Fuse features
        if self.fusion_method == 'concat':
            # Concatenate all resolutions
            fused = torch.cat(all_features, dim=1)
            
        elif self.fusion_method == 'add':
            # Weighted sum (requires same number of tokens)
            # Interpolate to match sizes if needed
            max_len = max(f.shape[1] for f in all_features)
            
            aligned_features = []
            for i, feat in enumerate(all_features):
                if feat.shape[1] != max_len:
                    # Interpolate
                    feat = feat.transpose(1, 2)  # [B, C, N]
                    feat = F.interpolate(feat, size=max_len, mode='linear')
                    feat = feat.transpose(1, 2)  # [B, N, C]
                aligned_features.append(feat)
            
            # Weighted sum
            weights = F.softmax(self.fusion_weights, dim=0)
            fused = sum(w * f for w, f in zip(weights, aligned_features))
            
        elif self.fusion_method == 'attention':
            # Attention-based fusion
            concat_features = torch.cat(all_features, dim=1)
            query = self.fusion_query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
            
            fused, _ = self.fusion_attention(
                query=query,
                key=concat_features,
                value=concat_features
            )
        
        return self.norm(fused)


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3792: Video Understanding with LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class VideoUnderstandingLLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Processes video inputs for LLM understanding using temporal modeling.
    Implements frame sampling, temporal encoding, and video-text alignment.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        frame_encoder_dim: int = 768,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_frames: int = 8,
        temporal_model: str = 'transformer',  # 'transformer', 'lstm', 'conv'
        num_temporal_layers: int = 4
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.num_frames = num_frames
        self.temporal_model = temporal_model
        
        # Frame-level encoder projection
        self.frame_projection = nn.Linear(frame_encoder_dim, hidden_dim)
        
        # Temporal position embeddings
        self.temporal_pos_embed = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, num_frames, hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Temporal modeling
        if temporal_model == 'transformer':
            encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=hidden_dim,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
                batch_first=True
            )
            self.temporal_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
                encoder_layer,
                num_layers=num_temporal_layers
            )
            
        elif temporal_model == 'lstm':
            self.temporal_encoder = nn.LSTM(
                input_size=hidden_dim,
                hidden_size=hidden_dim,
                num_layers=num_temporal_layers,
                batch_first=True,
                bidirectional=True
            )
            self.lstm_projection = nn.Linear(hidden_dim * 2, hidden_dim)
            
        elif temporal_model == 'conv':
            # Temporal 1D convolutions
            conv_layers = []
            for i in range(num_temporal_layers):
                conv_layers.extend([
                    nn.Conv1
```python
                    nn.Conv1d(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, kernel_size=3, padding=1),
                    nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden_dim),
                    nn.ReLU(),
                    nn.Dropout(0.1)
                ])
            self.temporal_encoder = nn.Sequential(*conv_layers)
        
        # Video-level pooling
        self.video_pooling = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.Tanh()
        )
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        frame_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, T, N, frame_encoder_dim]
        frame_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            frame_features: Features from each video frame
            frame_mask: Mask for valid frames
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with frame-level and video-level features
        """
        batch_size, num_frames, num_tokens, _ = frame_features.shape
        
        # Project frame features
        frame_features = self.frame_projection(frame_features)  # [B, T, N, hidden_dim]
        
        # Pool spatial tokens for each frame (mean pooling)
        frame_features = frame_features.mean(dim=2)  # [B, T, hidden_dim]
        
        # Add temporal position embeddings
        frame_features = frame_features + self.temporal_pos_embed[:, :num_frames, :]
        
        # Temporal modeling
        if self.temporal_model == 'transformer':
            temporal_features = self.temporal_encoder(frame_features)
            
        elif self.temporal_model == 'lstm':
            temporal_features, _ = self.temporal_encoder(frame_features)
            temporal_features = self.lstm_projection(temporal_features)
            
        elif self.temporal_model == 'conv':
            # Transpose for conv1d: [B, C, T]
            temporal_features = frame_features.transpose(1, 2)
            temporal_features = self.temporal_encoder(temporal_features)
            temporal_features = temporal_features.transpose(1, 2)  # Back to [B, T, C]
        
        temporal_features = self.norm(temporal_features)
        
        # Video-level representation (mean pooling over time)
        if frame_mask is not None:
            # Masked mean pooling
            mask_expanded = frame_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand_as(temporal_features)
            video_features = (temporal_features * mask_expanded).sum(dim=1) / mask_expanded.sum(dim=1)
        else:
            video_features = temporal_features.mean(dim=1)
        
        video_features = self.video_pooling(video_features)
        
        return {
            'frame_features': temporal_features,  # [B, T, hidden_dim]
            'video_features': video_features,      # [B, hidden_dim]
        }


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3793: Audio Understanding with LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class AudioUnderstandingLLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Processes audio inputs for LLM understanding using spectrogram or waveform features.
    Implements audio encoding, temporal modeling, and audio-text alignment.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        audio_encoder_dim: int = 768,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_audio_tokens: int = 128,
        use_spectrogram: bool = True,
        spec_channels: int = 128,
        temporal_pooling: str = 'attention'  # 'mean', 'max', 'attention'
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.use_spectrogram = use_spectrogram
        self.temporal_pooling = temporal_pooling
        
        if use_spectrogram:
            # Spectrogram processing (2D CNN)
            self.spec_encoder = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv2d(1, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(64),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(128),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.Conv2d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
                nn.BatchNorm2d(256),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((num_audio_tokens, 1))
            )
            self.spec_projection = nn.Linear(256, hidden_dim)
        else:
            # Waveform processing (1D CNN)
            self.wave_encoder = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Conv1d(1, 64, kernel_size=10, stride=5),
                nn.BatchNorm1d(64),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.Conv1d(64, 128, kernel_size=8, stride=4),
                nn.BatchNorm1d(128),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.Conv1d(128, 256, kernel_size=4, stride=2),
                nn.BatchNorm1d(256),
                nn.ReLU()
            )
            self.wave_projection = nn.Linear(256, hidden_dim)
        
        # Audio encoder projection
        self.audio_projection = nn.Linear(audio_encoder_dim, hidden_dim)
        
        # Temporal position embeddings
        self.position_embed = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, num_audio_tokens, hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Temporal transformer
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=hidden_dim,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
            batch_first=True
        )
        self.temporal_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=4)
        
        # Attention pooling
        if temporal_pooling == 'attention':
            self.pooling_query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
            self.pooling_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=hidden_dim,
                num_heads=8,
                batch_first=True
            )
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        audio_input: torch.Tensor,  # [B, T] waveform or [B, 1, F, T] spectrogram
        audio_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None  # Pre-extracted features [B, T, audio_encoder_dim]
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            audio_input: Raw audio waveform or spectrogram
            audio_features: Optional pre-extracted audio features
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with audio token features and pooled representation
        """
        batch_size = audio_input.shape[0]
        
        if audio_features is not None:
            # Use pre-extracted features
            audio_tokens = self.audio_projection(audio_features)
        elif self.use_spectrogram:
            # Process spectrogram
            spec_features = self.spec_encoder(audio_input)  # [B, 256, num_tokens, 1]
            spec_features = spec_features.squeeze(-1).transpose(1, 2)  # [B, num_tokens, 256]
            audio_tokens = self.spec_projection(spec_features)
        else:
            # Process waveform
            if audio_input.dim() == 2:
                audio_input = audio_input.unsqueeze(1)  # [B, 1, T]
            wave_features = self.wave_encoder(audio_input)  # [B, 256, T']
            wave_features = wave_features.transpose(1, 2)  # [B, T', 256]
            audio_tokens = self.wave_projection(wave_features)
        
        # Add position embeddings
        seq_len = audio_tokens.shape[1]
        audio_tokens = audio_tokens + self.position_embed[:, :seq_len, :]
        
        # Temporal modeling
        audio_tokens = self.temporal_transformer(audio_tokens)
        audio_tokens = self.norm(audio_tokens)
        
        # Pooling for global audio representation
        if self.temporal_pooling == 'mean':
            audio_pooled = audio_tokens.mean(dim=1)
        elif self.temporal_pooling == 'max':
            audio_pooled = audio_tokens.max(dim=1)[0]
        elif self.temporal_pooling == 'attention':
            query = self.pooling_query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
            audio_pooled, _ = self.pooling_attention(
                query=query,
                key=audio_tokens,
                value=audio_tokens
            )
            audio_pooled = audio_pooled.squeeze(1)
        
        return {
            'audio_tokens': audio_tokens,  # [B, T, hidden_dim]
            'audio_pooled': audio_pooled,  # [B, hidden_dim]
        }


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3794: 3D Understanding with LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class ThreeDUnderstandingLLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Processes 3D point clouds or voxel grids for LLM understanding.
    Implements 3D feature extraction and projection to language space.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        input_type: str = 'pointcloud',  # 'pointcloud' or 'voxel'
        num_points: int = 2048,
        point_dim: int = 3,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        num_layers: int = 4
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.input_type = input_type
        
        if input_type == 'pointcloud':
            # PointNet-style encoder
            self.point_encoder = PointNetEncoder(
                point_dim=point_dim,
                hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
                num_layers=num_layers
            )
        else:  # voxel
            # 3D CNN encoder
            self.voxel_encoder = Voxel3DEncoder(
                hidden_dim=hidden_dim
            )
        
        # Global feature extraction
        self.global_pooling = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
        )
        
        # Local-to-global attention
        self.local_global_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
            embed_dim=hidden_dim,
            num_heads=8,
            batch_first=True
        )
        
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim)
        
    def forward(
        self,
        input_3d: torch.Tensor  # [B, N, 3] for points or [B, C, D, H, W] for voxels
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            input_3d: 3D input (point cloud or voxel grid)
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with local and global 3D features
        """
        if self.input_type == 'pointcloud':
            local_features = self.point_encoder(input_3d)  # [B, N, hidden_dim]
        else:
            local_features = self.voxel_encoder(input_3d)  # [B, N, hidden_dim]
        
        # Global pooling
        global_features = local_features.max(dim=1)[0]  # [B, hidden_dim]
        global_features = self.global_pooling(global_features)
        
        # Enhance local features with global context
        global_expanded = global_features.unsqueeze(1)  # [B, 1, hidden_dim]
        enhanced_local, _ = self.local_global_attention(
            query=local_features,
            key=global_expanded,
            value=global_expanded
        )
        
        enhanced_local = self.norm(local_features + enhanced_local)
        
        return {
            'local_features': enhanced_local,  # [B, N, hidden_dim]
            'global_features': global_features,  # [B, hidden_dim]
        }


class PointNetEncoder(nn.Module):
    """PointNet-style encoder for point clouds"""
    def __init__(self, point_dim: int = 3, hidden_dim: int = 1024, num_layers: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Shared MLPs
        layers = []
        current_dim = point_dim
        dims = [64, 128, 256, hidden_dim][:num_layers]
        
        for dim in dims:
            layers.extend([
                nn.Linear(current_dim, dim),
                nn.BatchNorm1d(dim),
                nn.ReLU()
            ])
            current_dim = dim
        
        self.mlp = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Sequential(*layers[i*3:(i+1)*3]) for i in range(len(dims))
        ])
        
    def forward(self, points: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            points: [B, N, point_dim]
        Returns:
            features: [B, N, hidden_dim]
        """
        x = points
        for layer in self.mlp:
            # Apply per-point transformation
            b, n, c = x.shape
            x = x.reshape(b * n, c)
            x = layer(x)
            x = x.reshape(b, n, -1)
        
        return x


class Voxel3DEncoder(nn.Module):
    """3D CNN encoder for voxel grids"""
    def __init__(self, hidden_dim: int = 1024):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv3d(1, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm3d(64),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv3d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm3d(128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv3d(128, 256, kernel_size=3, stride=2, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm3d(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool3d((4, 4, 4))
        )
        
        self.projection = nn.Linear(256 * 4 * 4 * 4, hidden_dim)

# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3795: Embodied AI with LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class EmbodiedAILLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Integrates sensory inputs (vision, proprioception, tactile) with LLM for embodied AI.
    Implements multi-sensor fusion and action prediction.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        visual_dim: int = 768,
        proprioception_dim: int = 32,
        tactile_dim: int = 64,
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        action_dim: int = 7,
        num_fusion_layers: int = 4
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        # Modality-specific encoders
        self.visual_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(visual_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        
        self.proprioception_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(proprioception_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        
        self.tactile_encoder = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(tactile_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.ReLU()
        )
        
        # Modality tokens for identification
        self.visual_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
        self.proprio_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
        self.tactile_token = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
        
        # Fusion transformer
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=hidden_dim,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=hidden_dim * 4,
            batch_first=True
        )
        self.fusion_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            encoder_layer,
            num_layers=num_fusion_layers
        )
        
        # Action prediction head
        self.action_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, action_dim)
        )
        
        # Value estimation head (for RL)
        self.value_head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim // 2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim // 2, 1)
        )
        
    def forward(
        self,
        visual_features: torch.Tensor,  # [B, N_v, visual_dim]
        proprioception: torch.Tensor,   # [B, proprioception_dim]
        tactile_features: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # [B, N_t, tactile_dim]
        language_instruction: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,  # [B, N_l, hidden_dim]
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            visual_features: Visual observations
            proprioception: Robot joint angles, velocities, etc.
            tactile_features: Optional tactile sensor readings
            language_instruction: Optional language instruction embeddings
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with actions, values, and fused representations
        """
        batch_size = visual_features.shape[0]
        
        # Encode each modality
        visual_encoded = self.visual_encoder(visual_features)  # [B, N_v, hidden_dim]
        proprio_encoded = self.proprioception_encoder(proprioception).unsqueeze(1)  # [B, 1, hidden_dim]
        
        # Add modality tokens
        visual_encoded = visual_encoded + self.visual_token
        proprio_encoded = proprio_encoded + self.proprio_token
        
        # Collect all modalities
        modality_features = [visual_encoded, proprio_encoded]
        
        if tactile_features is not None:
            tactile_encoded = self.tactile_encoder(tactile_features)
            tactile_encoded = tactile_encoded + self.tactile_token
            modality_features.append(tactile_encoded)
        
        if language_instruction is not None:
            modality_features.append(language_instruction)
        
        # Concatenate all modalities
        fused_input = torch.cat(modality_features, dim=1)  # [B, N_total, hidden_dim]
        
        # Fusion through transformer
        fused_features = self.fusion_transformer(fused_input)
        
        # Global representation (mean pooling)
        global_repr = fused_features.mean(dim=1)  # [B, hidden_dim]
        
        # Predict actions and value
        actions = self.action_head(global_repr)  # [B, action_dim]
        value = self.value_head(global_repr)  # [B, 1]
        
        return {
            'actions': actions,
            'value': value,
            'fused_features': fused_features,
            'global_representation': global_repr
        }


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3796: Sensor Fusion with LLM Pattern
# ============================================================================
class SensorFusionLLM(nn.Module):
    """
    Fuses multiple heterogeneous sensors (camera, lidar, radar, IMU) for LLM processing.
    Implements adaptive fusion with attention-based weighting.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        sensor_configs: Dict[str, int],  # e.g., {'camera': 768, 'lidar': 256, 'radar': 128}
        hidden_dim: int = 1024,
        fusion_strategy: str = 'attention',  # 'concat', 'attention', 'gated'
        num_fusion_heads: int = 8
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.sensor_configs = sensor_configs
        self.fusion_strategy = fusion_strategy
        
        # Sensor-specific encoders
        self.sensor_encoders = nn.ModuleDict({
            name: nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(dim, hidden_dim),
                nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim)
            )
            for name, dim in sensor_configs.items()
        })
        
        # Sensor type embeddings
        self.sensor_type_embeddings = nn.ParameterDict({
            name: nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
            for name in sensor_configs.keys()
        })
        
        if fusion_strategy == 'attention':
            # Multi-head attention fusion
            self.fusion_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=hidden_dim,
                num_heads=num_fusion_heads,
                batch_first=True
            )
            self.fusion_query = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 1, hidden_dim))
            
        elif fusion_strategy == 'gated':
            # Gated fusion mechanism
            num_sensors = len(sensor_configs)
            self.gate_network = nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(hidden_dim * num_sensors, hidden_dim),
                nn.ReLU(),
                nn.Linear(hidden_dim, num_sensors),
                nn.Softmax(dim=-1)
            )
        
        # Post-fusion processing
        self.post_fusion = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim),
            nn.LayerNorm(hidden_dim),
            nn.GELU()
        )
        
    def forward(
        self,
        sensor_inputs: Dict[str, torch.Tensor],  # Dict of sensor name -> [B, N, sensor_dim]
        sensor_masks: Optional[Dict[str, torch.Tensor]] = None
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        Args:
            sensor_inputs: Dictionary mapping sensor names to their features
            sensor_masks: Optional masks for each sensor
            
        Returns:
            Dictionary with fused features and per-sensor encodings
        """
        batch_size = list(sensor_inputs.values())[0].shape[0]
        
        # Encode each sensor
        encoded_sensors = {}
        all_sensor_features = []
        
        for sensor_name, features in sensor_inputs.items():
            # Encode sensor features
            encoded = self.sensor_encoders[sensor_name](features)
            
            # Add sensor type embedding
            type_embed = self.sensor_type_embeddings[sensor_name]
            encoded = encoded + type_embed
            
            encoded_sensors[sensor_name] = encoded
            all_sensor_features.append(encoded)
        
        # Fusion strategy
        if self.fusion_strategy == 'concat':
            # Simple concatenation
            fused = torch.cat(all_sensor_features, dim=1)
            
        elif self.fusion_strategy == 'attention':
            # Attention-based fusion
            concat_features = torch.cat(all_sensor_features, dim=1)
            query = self.fusion_query.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
            
            fused, attention_weights = self.fusion_attention(
                query=query,
                key=concat_features,
                value=concat_features
            )
            
        elif self.fusion_strategy == 'gated':
            # Gated fusion with learned weights
            # Pool each sensor to fixed size
            pooled_sensors = [feat.mean(dim=1) for feat in all_sensor_features]
            concat_pooled = torch.cat(pooled_sensors, dim=-1)
            
            # Compute gates
            gates = self.gate_network(concat_pooled)  # [B, num_sensors]
            
            # Weighted combination
            fused = sum(
                gate.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2) * feat
                for gate, feat in zip(gates.unbind(dim=1), all_sensor_features)
            )
        
        # Post-fusion processing
        fused = self.post_fusion(fused)
        
        return {
            'fused_features': fused,
            'sensor_encodings': encoded_sensors,
            'attention_weights': attention_weights if self.fusion_strategy == 'attention' else None
        }


# ============================================================================
# Pattern 3797: Any-to-Any Modality Pattern
# ============================================================================
class AnyToAnyModality(nn.Module):
    """
    Universal modality translation supporting any-to-any conversions.
    Implements a shared latent space for arbitrary modality pairs.
    """
    def __init__(
        self,
        modalities: List[str] = ['text', 'image', 'audio', 'video'],
        modality_dims: Dict[str, int] = None,
        latent_dim: int = 1024,
        num_latent_tokens: int = 64
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.modalities = modalities
        self.latent_dim = latent_dim
        
        if modality_dims is None:
            modality_dims = {mod: 768 for mod in modalities}
        
        # Encoders: modality -> latent space
        self.encoders = nn.ModuleDict({
            mod: nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(modality_dims[mod], latent_dim),
                nn.LayerNorm(latent_dim),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.Linear(latent_dim, latent_dim)
            )
            for mod in modalities
        })
        
        # Decoders: latent space -> modality
        self.decoders = nn.ModuleDict({
            mod: nn.Sequential(
                nn.Linear(latent_dim, latent_dim),
                nn.GELU(),
                nn.LayerNorm(latent_dim),
                nn.Linear(latent_dim, modality_dims[mod])
            )
            for mod in modalities
        })
        
        # Shared latent transformer
        self.latent_tokens = nn.Parameter(
            torch.randn(1, num_latent_tokens, latent_dim)
        )
        
        encoder_layer = nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model=latent_dim,
            nhead=8,
            dim_feedforward=latent_dim * 4,
            batch_first=True
        )
        self.latent_transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(encoder_layer, num_layers=6)
        
        # Modality-specific queries for decoding
        self.decoder_queries = nn.ParameterDict({
            mod: nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, num_latent_tokens, latent_dim))
            for mod in modalities
        })
        
        # Cross-attention for decoding
        self.decoder_cross_attention = nn.ModuleDict({
            mod: nn.MultiheadAttention(
                embed_dim=latent_dim,
                num_heads=8,
                batch_first=True
            )
            for mod in modalities
        })
        
    def encode(
        self,
        features: torch.Tensor,
        source_modality: str
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Encode source modality to latent space"""
        encoded = self.encoders[source_modality](features)
        
        # Merge with latent tokens
        batch_size = features.shape[0]
        latent_tokens = self.latent_tokens.expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        # Concatenate and process
        combined = torch.cat([latent_tokens, encoded], dim=1)
        latent_repr = self.latent_transformer(combined)
        
        return latent_repr
    
    def decode(
        self,
        latent_repr: torch.Tensor,
        target_modality: str
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """Decode latent representation to target modality"""
        batch_size = latent_repr.shape[0]
        
        # Get modality-specific query
        query = self.decoder_queries[target_modality].expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
        
        # Cross-attention to latent representation
        decoded, _ = self.decoder_cross_attention[target_modality](
            query=query,
            key=latent_repr,
            value=latent_repr
        )
        
        # Project to target modality space
        output = self.decoders[target_modality](decoded)
        
        return output
    
    def forward(
        self,
        source_features: torch.Tensor,
        source_modality: str,
        target_modality: str
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Args:
            source_features: Features from source modality [B, N, source_dim]
            source_modality: Name of source modality
            target_modality: Name of target modality
            
        Returns:
            Translated features in target modality space
        """
        # Encode to latent space
        latent_repr = self.encode(source_features, source_modality)
        
        # Decode to target modality
        target_features = self.decode(latent_repr, target_modality)
        
        return target_features
